chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Al-Hakam ibn Miskeen, from Huzayfa ibn Mansur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The most veiled and most concealed (place) from where Satan overcomes a son of Adam is that he settles underneath the nails.
ai.seo_question: How does Satan influence humans through neglect of fingernails?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) identifies the accumulation of dirt under the fingernails as a subtle mechanism for Satan's influence, linking physical neglect to spiritual vulnerability. This hadith, found in *Al-Kafi*, underscores the Shia emphasis on *taharah* (purity) not merely as ritual cleanliness but as a holistic state that prevents the 'whisperings' of Satan from taking root in the body's hidden crevices. The narration serves as a practical reminder that minor acts of self-neglect can facilitate greater spiritual distraction.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Al Hakam Bin Miskeyn, from Huzayfa Bin Mansour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The most veiled and most concealed (place) from where the Satan<sup>la</sup> overcomes a son of Adam<sup>as</sup> is that he<sup>la</sup> settles underneath the nails’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Muhammad ibn Ali from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
’The strongest cover and most secret place for Satan by which he dominates children of Adam, Alayhi al-Salam is his hiding under the fingernails.’”
